content:
The Laredo Police Department reported a three-car accident on the northbound lanes of Loop 20 in front of the car dealerships on Thursday evening, November 5, 2026.

Police issued the advisory at 8:09 p.m., urging drivers to use caution in the area and to expect significant delays.

No further details were included in the advisory. Drivers traveling northbound on Loop 20 should allow extra time and consider an alternate route.

Source: Laredo Police Department, November 5, 2026.
